details_text:
☕ Size: Standard mug, ~12 oz
🎨 Style:  hand-painted glaze
🍽️ Safety: Food safe, dishwasher safe
⏱️ Turnaround: ~6 weeks
🎁 Great for: Dog lovers, birthdays, holidays
name: Dog Portrait Mug
story: Pup on the side:  a sweet companion for your morning joe or cup of tea.  Send me a photo and I will hand paint a likeness of your special furry friend,  a spaniel, a doodle or a bully mix--it's all up to you!
snippet: A whimsical mug that starts every morning with a smile.
